summary.intent: Complete phase 65 wave 4/4 (plan 65-07): add the D-04 write-chain rotation E2E test suite and fix a missing sdk-core barrel export so the suite's imports resolve.
summary.outcome: All 7 phase-65 plans implemented and verified; D-04 live gate passed (2 tests, 524ms) against the real API, confirming WRITE-02/03/04 write-revocation and rotation flows end-to-end.

repo: 65-06 added rotateWriteFromNode/WriteRevocationCallbacks to rotation/index.ts but did not re-export them from the sdk-core top-level barrel (packages/sdk-core/src/index.ts); the omission only surfaces when E2E tests import from the package root.

The sdk-e2e test suite has pre-existing TypeScript errors in batch-upload, ipns-consistency, and file-operations suites caused by removed types (FolderChild, FilePointer, SealedChildRef.id/.type) from an earlier metadata refactor — these are tech debt unrelated to phase 65.

The running API TEST_LOGIN_SECRET (apps/api/.env) is 'e2e-test-secret-ci-only', but the sdk-e2e default SDK_E2E_SECRET is 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production'; these must be matched manually when running E2E suites locally.
Vitest file-pattern filtering (-- write-chain-rotation) isolates the target suite so broken sibling suites do not block the gate.
The API health endpoint returns 200 and can be probed before running E2E suites to confirm the docker stack is live.

code.finding: Two lines added to re-export rotateWriteFromNode and WriteRevocationCallbacks at the package root — required for E2E imports to resolve after 65-06 added them only to rotation/index.ts.
New D-04 gate suite covering write-revocation (new k51 name minting), parent re-point cascade, tombstone-intent firing, and surviving co-writer re-wrap. Zero type errors at time of commit.

workflow: When an E2E executor consolidates two tasks into one commit because they write to the same file atomically, this is acceptable as a minor process deviation — document it in the summary rather than splitting artificially.
pnpm typecheck does not cover sdk-e2e; a separate tsc invocation on that package is needed to verify E2E suite types.
Pre-existing type errors in unrelated E2E suites should be confirmed as pre-existing via git log before being flagged, to avoid blocking a phase gate on unrelated debt.

friction: Live D-04 gate initially failed with 401 due to SDK_E2E_SECRET mismatch between apps/api/.env ('e2e-test-secret-ci-only') and the sdk-e2e default — required manual discovery and re-run.
Phase 65-06 silently omitted the sdk-core barrel export for rotateWriteFromNode; the gap was only caught when 65-07 tried to write an E2E import against the package root.
open_items: Pre-existing TypeScript errors in sdk-e2e suites (batch-upload, ipns-consistency, file-operations) referencing removed types FolderChild/FilePointer/SealedChildRef.id/.type — tech debt from earlier metadata refactor, not yet addressed.
Live E2E gate for D-04 requires docker stack and correct SDK_E2E_SECRET; CI configuration should ensure these are aligned so the gate is not environment-dependent.
